Types: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Findings.Title: S3 general purpose buckets should block public read access
Findings.Description: The S3 bucket public-assets is publicly accessible because block public access is disabled; its contents are exposed to the internet.

Recommendation.Text: Enable S3 Block Public Access and remove public bucket policies/ACLs.

Types: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Findings.Title: S3 general purpose buckets should have server-side encryption enabled
Findings.Description: Default encryption is not enabled for bucket billing-archive, so objects are stored unencrypted.

Recommendation.Text: Enable default encryption (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS) on the bucket.

Types: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Findings.Title: IAM policies should not allow full administrative privileges
Findings.Description: The customer managed policy build-admin grants Action: * on Resource: *, an overly permissive wildcard equivalent to AdministratorAccess.

Recommendation.Text: Rewrite the policy to grant only the specific actions and resources required.

Types: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Findings.Title: MFA should be enabled for all IAM users that have a console password
Findings.Description: IAM user analyst-jane has a console password but no MFA device registered.

Recommendation.Text: Register a virtual or hardware MFA device for the user.

Types: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Findings.Title: Security groups should not allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 22
Findings.Description: Security group sg-0ssh allows unrestricted ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 22, leaving SSH open to the world.

Recommendation.Text: Restrict port 22 ingress to specific admin CIDRs or use SSM Session Manager.

Types: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Findings.Title: Security groups should only allow unrestricted incoming traffic for authorized ports
Findings.Description: Security group sg-0open allows ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 on all ports.

Recommendation.Text: Remove the 0.0.0.0/0 rule and allow only required ports from known sources.

Types: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Findings.Title: Attached EBS volumes should be encrypted at rest
Findings.Description: EBS volume vol-0abc is not encrypted.

Recommendation.Text: Enable EBS default encryption and migrate data to an encrypted volume.

Types: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Findings.Title: RDS DB instances should prohibit public access
Findings.Description: RDS instance payments-db is publicly accessible from the internet and storage encryption is not enabled.

Recommendation.Text: Disable public accessibility, move to private subnets, and enable storage encryption.

Types: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Findings.Title: RDS DB instances should have encryption at rest enabled
Findings.Description: Storage encryption is not enabled for RDS instance reporting-db.

Recommendation.Text: Re-create the instance from an encrypted snapshot with storage encryption enabled.

Types: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Findings.Title: CloudTrail should be enabled with at least one multi-Region trail
Findings.Description: CloudTrail is not enabled for this account; management event logging disabled across all regions.

Recommendation.Text: Create a multi-region organization trail capturing management events.

Types: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Findings.Title: KMS customer managed keys should have key rotation enabled
Findings.Description: Automatic key rotation is not enabled for customer managed key alias/reports.

Recommendation.Text: Enable automatic annual rotation for the key.

Types: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Findings.Title: KMS key policies should not grant public access
Findings.Description: Key policy for alias/exports allows kms:* for Principal * (public access), which is overly permissive.

Recommendation.Text: Scope the key policy to specific principals and remove the wildcard principal.

Types: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Findings.Title: S3 general purpose buckets should have versioning enabled
Findings.Description: Versioning is enabled for bucket billing-archive.
